variants.label: Sources sidebar
variants.notes: Sources on the left grouped as All, System, Services, Files and your Watchers, with counts. Histogram by level, live stream, entry details with surrounding lines. “Watch a file” opens a small form.

variants.label: Source pills
variants.notes: Sources as pills on top: All plus one per source, several can be active together. Query search (level:error OR …), histogram, stream and details panel.

variants.label: Source cards
variants.notes: A card per source with count, errors and a sparkline: you see at a glance where the trouble is. Clicking cards filters the merged stream, each line marked with its source colour.
